title: Taxes Made Simple (India): A Roadmap for First-Time Filers
description: Understand income tax basics, documents, filing steps, deductions, and compliance in India.

nodes.label: What is Income Tax?
nodes.description: A tax on your annual income paid to the Government of India. Collected via TDS, advance tax, or self-assessment at filing.

nodes.label: Tax Regimes & Slabs
nodes.description: India offers regimes with different slab structures and deductions. Choose based on your income, deductions, and simplicity preference.

nodes.label: PAN, Aadhaar, Bank
nodes.description: You need PAN, Aadhaar (linked), and a pre-validated bank account for refunds and e-verification.

nodes.label: Form 26AS & AIS
nodes.description: 26AS and AIS summarize TDS, TCS, interest, securities trades, etc. Reconcile these with your records.

nodes.label: Choosing ITR Forms
nodes.description: Pick ITR-1/2/3/4 based on income sources like salary, capital gains, or business/profession.

nodes.label: How to File Online
nodes.description: Register/login on the e-Filing portal, prefill data, add incomes/deductions, compute tax, pay dues, submit, then e-verify.

nodes.label: e-Verification
nodes.description: Complete within the deadline using Aadhaar OTP, net banking, or bank/demat EVC to make your return valid.

nodes.label: Deductions & Exemptions
nodes.description: Common sections include investments, health insurance premiums, and HRA/LTA rules. Keep proofs and follow limits.

nodes.label: TDS & Advance Tax
nodes.description: Employees see TDS in salary; self-employed may need advance tax instalments based on estimated income.

nodes.label: Notices & Rectification
nodes.description: Respond to notices on time. Use rectification/revised return if you spot errors.

nodes.label: Test Yourself: Taxes
nodes.description: Quick check on regimes, ITR selection, documents, and verification.
